description: This PHP source file defines the class FormatWithSmoker which implements a value formatting strategy for determining if an individual is a smoker. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Maintenance Access Strategy module, and provides a simple method to return 'Smoker' if the input value indicates true, or null otherwise.

classes.name: FormatWithSmoker
classes.description: Implements the ValueFormatter interface to format a value as 'Smoker' if true, or null otherwise.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns 'Smoker' if the input value is truthy, otherwise returns null.
